Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On passage Passed by the Yeas and Nays: 223 - 206 (Roll no. 64). (text of amendment in the nature of a substitute: CR H2150)
Passed/agreed to in House: On passage Passed by the Yeas and Nays: 223 - 206 (Roll no. 64).
On motion to recommit Failed by the Yeas and Nays: 214 - 215 (Roll no. 63).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H2167-2169)

POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H.R. 3617, the Chair put the question on the motion to recommit and by voice vote, announced the noes had prevailed. Mr. Landsman demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
The previous question on the motion to recommit was ordered pursuant to clause 2(b) of rule XIX.
Mr. Landsman moved to recommit to the Committee on Energy and Commerce. (text: CR H2154)
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H.R. 3617.

Rule provides for consideration of S. 1383, H.R. 2189, H.R. 261 and H.R. 3617. The resolution provides for consideration of S. 1383, H.R. 2189, H.R. 261, and H.R. 3617 under a closed rule and provides for one motion to recommit H.R. 2189, H.R. 261, and H.R. 3617, and one motion to commit S. 1383.

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal agencies, the energy sector, states, and other stakeholders concerned with energy security and supply chains.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Energy, in consultation with the appropriate Federal agencies, representatives of the energy sector, States, and other stakeholders

dimensions.assessment: Directs ongoing assessments, strategy development, and a report, serving as an administrative policy framework rather than direct intervention.
dimensions.evidence: conduct ongoing assessments of energy resource criticality... facilitate development of strategies

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific funding amounts or fiscal appropriations.
Expands the duties and functions of the Department of Energy to explicitly cover critical energy resource supply chains.
dimensions.evidence: Functions that relate to securing the supply of critical energy resources

dimensions.assessment: Mandates ongoing duties for the Department of Energy alongside a report due within two years.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than two years after the date of enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Energy shall submit... a report

missing_information: Specific funding levels or budgetary allocations for carrying out the assessments and strategies.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Department of Energy to conduct ongoing assessments and develop strategies regarding critical energy resource supply chains, resulting in an administrative report to Congress.
